reason: The commit only generalizes the name of the invalid Content-Length error constant and updates the existing HTTP/1 response-header error path to reference that renamed constant. It does not add or alter an input-processing entry point, initialization or configuration requirement, protocol behavior, or input constraint. The existing server fuzz driver does not reference either error symbol, and its reverse-proxy setup and upstream response behavior require no adaptation to compile or operate after this change.
evidence: In lib/common/http1client.c, on_head retains the same h2o_strtosize check and error return; only the error constant passed to on_error_before_head changes.
In lib/common/httpclient.c, the associated string remains exactly "invalid content-length"; only the exported identifier and declaration ordering change.
Neither fuzz/driver.cc nor fuzz/driver_url.cc refers to h2o_httpclient_error_http1_invalid_content_length or h2o_httpclient_error_invalid_content_length.
recommended_action: No fuzz-harness maintenance is required for this commit.
